name: lago
description: Design, implement, and test usage-based billing with Lago, the open-source billing engine: usage events, plans, credits, wallets, invoices, and migrations, starting with an offline demo that needs no credentials.

lago_api_url.title: Lago API URL
lago_api_url.description: Optional. The Lago API endpoint for live work you start: Lago Cloud US by default, https://api.eu.getlago.com for EU, or your self-hosted URL. Not a secret. The plugin never asks for an API key; your Lago CLI or MCP connection keeps its own.
